summary: TB-EM-003/004 (center provisioning and staff onboarding) tested end to end in a real browser on the public preview URL, plus 15 API security pytest checks (15/15 pass). Every requested flow works. The platform admin can use the nav and the centers list with search. Direct creation works: the empty submit shows the validation summary, a duplicate name gives a 409 error, the redirect goes to ?created=1 with a notice, and the admin card shows 'Invited'. Provisioning from an APPROVED application works: the form is prefilled, view-center-button appears, the history shows 'Center provisioned', and a second provisioning attempt is refused. The first-admin lifecycle works: resend rotates the token (old link returns 404), replace marks the old link REPLACED, revoke marks it REVOKED, and invite-admin-button reappears. The center history card shows every event. Acceptance by a new user works: the strong password policy runs on the client, the user lands in /app as Center administrator of the right center, and reusing the link shows invite-ended. Acceptance by an existing user (leila) works: sign-in-required, then /login?next=invite, back to /invite, invite-accept-button, and the session switches to the new center. invite-wrong-account appears for the wrong signed-in account. Onboarding works: the 4 steps complete automatically from center save, profile save and a staff invite, review_permissions completes manually, progress persists after reload, and the home banner disappears at 4/4. Staff invites work with several roles and a specialty, the duplicate error, and resend/revoke in the Invitations tab. Roles are correct: a multi-role user lands as CLINICAL_SUPERVISOR with Switch and no Team; the coordinator sees Team read-only (no invite, resend/revoke, edit or access cards). The directory search and the role, status and specialty filters work, including the empty state. On the member page, role and title edits persist, suspend needs a reason, a suspended user loses access, reactivate and revoke work, the revoked filter works, the own profile shows the self-note, and history is recorded. Mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow on any new page. One real bug found: on a fresh load of the /invite page in the preview, a 'Security check failed' error appears (a CSRF race).

ui_bugs.issue: A fresh load of a valid invitation link shows a red 'Security check failed. Refresh the page and try again.' alert (invite-load-error) above the valid invite-summary and activation form. The alert stays there while the user fills in the form. For an invalid or rotated link (an old link after a resend), this CSRF error replaces the correct 'This invitation link is not valid' message. RCA: the preview runs `next dev` with reactStrictMode:true, so the useEffect runs twice. Each run calls centersApi.inspectInvite, then publicPost, then preToken(), which is GET /api/auth/csrf and rotates the pre-auth cookie. The two calls run at the same time, so one POST /api/invitations/inspect is sent with a token that no longer matches the cookie and gets a 403. Its setError then shows next to the other call's setPreview. This also uses up 2 of the 30 public invitation requests allowed per network per 15 minutes on every page view.
The page reads the token only once, on mount. If a second invite link is opened in the same tab (a same-document hash change), the previous invitation's state stays on screen.

After a resend or revoke in the Invitations tab, the old page-level team-notice (e.g. 'Invitation sent to leila…') still shows above the new tab notice ('A new link was sent to test-ther…'). Two success banners with different messages appear at once.

Opening /app/centers/new?applicationId=<already provisioned id> shows the full prefilled form with no warning. The 'already provisioned' error only appears after submit. The prefill step should detect this and link to the existing center.

issues: An empty submit shows only the first error ('Enter the person's full name.'), not every missing field (email, role).
The work-unit status page is out of date. It still says 'Only TB-EM-000 and TB-EM-001 checkpoint 0 are built' and lists TB-EM-001 as PLANNED.
The same person appears twice: once as the 'Active' member and once as the 'Accepted' invitation. Consider collapsing accepted invitations into the member entry.

action_items: HIGH: Fix the /invite CSRF race. In lib/auth.ts, make preToken() share one in-flight promise across concurrent callers. Also add an ignore flag (or a ref) in the InvitePage useEffect so that StrictMode's second run neither fires a duplicate inspect nor applies stale results. Check the other pages that call publicPost from an effect, such as password reset.
LOW: Clear team-notice when switching tabs or when a new tab-level notice appears.
LOW: Re-run inspect on a hashchange in /invite.
LOW: On /app/centers/new?applicationId=, show the 'already provisioned' state with a link to the existing center before the user submits.
LOW: Update the work-unit status list on the root page.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/auth.ts preToken() fetches a new pre-auth token on every public call, and each fetch rotates the cookie, so any two concurrent public calls race. Make it safe for concurrent use.
invite/page.tsx useEffect has no cleanup or ignore flag, so the results of two parallel inspect calls can both land in state (preview and error together).

Security verified: no tokenHash or token in any API response (create, detail, invitation list, inspect, accept). No '#token=' in supervisor logs. The outbox is not served over HTTP (404). A center admin gets 403 on /api/platform/*. Cross-tenant staff, member and settings requests return 404. A coordinator gets 403 on invite and settings PATCH. A therapist gets 403 on the directory. Inviting CENTER_ADMIN as a center admin returns 400. Suspending yourself returns 422. Suspension revokes the live session at once. accept-new is refused for an email that already has an account.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; one HIGH UI error-state bug on /invite)

No seeded Harbor/Cedar account status was changed. Leila only gained a membership in the TEST_ center. A pending invite for supervisor@harbor to a TEST_ center was revoked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/tests && python -m pytest test_tb_em_003_004_centers_api.py -p no:cacheprovider -W ignore (it creates a new TEST_ API Center each run and uses about 6 public invitation calls, against a limit of 30 per 15 minutes). Browser scripts can read the outbox (/app/apps/api/.outbox/*.json) and the creds file directly. After the fix, retest /invite on a fresh load (go to about:blank first, then /invite#token=...): invite-load-error must not appear next to invite-summary, and an old link from before a resend must show 'This invitation link is not valid'.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: open any fresh invitation link (/invite#token=...) in a new tab on the preview. The red 'Security check failed' alert appears next to the invitation summary. Cause: React 18 StrictMode in `next dev` runs the mount effect twice. That makes two parallel GET /api/auth/csrf calls; each sets a new pre-auth cookie, so the earlier csrfToken no longer matches and its inspect POST gets a 403. Fix: share one in-flight preToken promise and guard the effect with a cancelled flag.
